blurb: Guests play paintball or airsoft on multiple fields including woods, urban, hyperball, and tournament style. The park provides rental equipment, enforces safety rules, and hosts open play and special events. Paintball ammo and air fills are available for purchase on site.
extraNote: Deposit required to reserve time slot, applied to game upon arrival · Players can be removed if under influence of alcohol or drugs · No arguing or fighting tolerated; cheating results in warnings and ejection
